run_DTWCPDDetector: run the DTWCPDDetector on multivariate time series data to detect changepoints using dynamic time warping distance
create_DTWCPDDetector: create a DTWCPDDetector instance with sliding window size, skip size, and MAD threshold parameters for changepoint detection
compute_DTWDistance: compute the DTW distance between two numeric sequences using the DTWDistance static method with a window constraint
compute_LB_Keogh: compute the LB Keogh lower bound on DTW distance between two time series for fast pruning
detect_DTWCPD_anomalies: detect anomalous subsequences in multivariate time series by finding those significantly dissimilar from historical patterns
